patterns.reminder: Use load_instruction_at_checked / load_current_index_checked with an address-checked instructions sysvar. The unchecked loaders let an attacker pass a fake sysvar and forge signature checks (Wormhole, Feb 2022).
Unchecked account: add a /// CHECK: comment and explicit owner or address validation, or use Account<'info, T> so Anchor checks owner and discriminator.
init_if_needed allows reinitialization unless existing state is checked. Prefer init, or prove the account is fresh.
Use transfer_checked (it verifies mint and decimals) for every USDC transfer.
